note: Advisory exemptions for defects that already exist in the tree and are owned by a named week. A gate that consults this file still PRINTS the finding, but does not fail on it. Every entry needs id, assertion, patterns, owner, closingWeek and reason. An entry missing any of those — or whose closingWeek has already gone GREEN in containment/GATE-LEDGER.json — is itself a gate failure, so an exemption cannot quietly outlive its fix. The list may only shrink. It was emptied on 2026-11-19: every entry (PR-01..04, PR-07) exempted paths under the docs/phase-2 instruction corpus that the documentation purge removed, so each one exempted nothing and would have been a stale allowance — the same defect the shrink-only rule exists to prevent.
